metadata.explanation: Task requires two tabs to be open: one on the United Airlines checked bags page and one on the fee calculator. llm_judge_reasons: Getter get_open_tabs_info correctly extracts all open Chrome tab URLs as a list of {'title', 'url'} dicts, which is exactly what the metric needs.
Metric correctly handles expected.type='rule': accesses expected.get('tab1_pattern') and expected.get('tab2_pattern') directly (expected IS the rules dict, not wrapped in {'rules': ...}).
URL patterns 'baggage/checked-bags' and 'checked-bag-fee-calculator' correctly match the actual United Airlines URLs observed in the source trajectory.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 per matching tab) provides correct coverage for both instruction requirements.
Negative control resistance is sound: initial state only has the United homepage, so neither pattern matches and score is 0.0.
No postconfig needed since tab URLs persist after navigation — no dialog or UI state dependency.
Edge cases handled: empty or string result returns 0.0 immediately.
